performance.verdict: Zero conversions in 28 days — tracking is broken before creative or budget matters.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: 0 leads from $504.89 Google spend over 28 days, 115 clicks. No conversion event has ever fired — tracking is not a decline, it is absent.
5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL build gaps, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all past Aug 31 deadline.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 9 consecutive days (Aug 28–Sep 5), down from a peak of 11 on Aug 21 — listing issue or suspension probable.
Google spend +44.21% WoW (avg $19.82/day last 7d) with zero results; 3-day signal (Sep 3–5: $45.16 total) vs prior 3 (Aug 31–Sep 2: $39.23) — spend rising into a confirmed broken funnel.
GHL shows 120 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — with 0 ad leads, opportunity creation source is unclear; possible manual or organic entries masking intake gap.

suggestions.text: Pause all Google Ads spend immediately until conversion tracking fires at least 1 confirmed event in GA4 or GHL.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause Google Ads campaigns now to stop burning budget ($504.89 spent, 0 conversions in 28 days). Tag team must verify the conversion pixel fires on the thank-you page or GHL form submission — confirm at least 1 test conversion recorded in GA4 or Google Ads before any spend resumes. Success check: 1 verified test conversion event visible in both Google Ads and GA4 by 2026-09-09. Do not reactivate spend until this is confirmed.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing: 0 actions for 9 days after Aug 21 peak of 11 — check for suspension or ownership issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to zero for 9 consecutive days (Aug 28–Sep 5) after recording 11 actions on Aug 21. Log into Google Business Profile dashboard and check for suspension notice, ownership conflict, or policy flag. Success check: GBP actions return to >0 within 3 days of any corrective action taken. Re-check 2026-09-09.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL opportunity source: 120 opps created with 0 ad leads — identify entry point before attributing pipeline health to ads.
